library(writexl)
library(muscat)

```{r}
do_kegg_for_sheet <- function(gene_vec, sheet_name = NULL) {
  genes <- bitr(gene_vec, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes$ENTREZID), ]
  if (nrow(genes) == 0) {
    if(!is.null(sheet_name))
      message("SKIPPING: No genes mapped for sheet ", sheet_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  kegg_gsa <- enrichKEGG(gene = genes$ENTREZID, organism = 'mmu', pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  # <-- NEW CHECK HERE
  if (is.null(kegg_gsa) || is.null(kegg_gsa@result) || nrow(kegg_gsa@result) == 0) {
    message("SKIPPING: KEGG returned NULL for sheet ", sheet_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  kegg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_gsa@result)
  sig_end_common_up <- kegg_df[kegg_df$p.adjust < 0.05, ]
  if (nrow(sig_end_common_up) == 0) {
    sig_end_common_up$gene_symbols <- character(0)
    return(sig_end_common_up)
  }
  all_entrez <- unique(unlist(strsplit(sig_end_common_up$geneID, "/")))
  id_map <- bitr(
    all_entrez,
    fromType = "ENTREZID",
    toType   = "SYMBOL",
    OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
  )
  entrez2symbol <- setNames(id_map$SYMBOL, id_map$ENTREZID)
  convert_core_enrichment <- function(entrez_string, lookup) {
    entrez_ids <- strsplit(entrez_string, "/")[[1]]
    symbols <- lookup[entrez_ids]
    symbols <- symbols[!is.na(symbols)]
    paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
  }
  sig_end_common_up$gene_symbols <- sapply(
    sig_end_common_up$geneID,
    convert_core_enrichment,
    lookup = entrez2symbol
  )
  return(sig_end_common_up)
}
```

#Common degs
```{r}
set.seed(6335)
excel_path <- "~/common_degs.xlsx"
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(excel_path)
results_list <- list()
for (sheet in sheet_names) {
  message("Processing sheet: ", sheet)
  end_common_up <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = sheet)
  symbols <- as.vector(end_common_up$Gene_Name)
  res <- do_kegg_for_sheet(symbols)
  results_list[[sheet]] <- res
}
write.xlsx(results_list, file = "GSEA_common.xlsx")
```

#PER UNICI
```{r}
set.seed(6335)
excel_path <- "~/per_git/genes_unici.xlsx"
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(excel_path)
results_list <- list()
for (sheet in sheet_names) {
  message("Processing sheet: ", sheet)
  end_common_up <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = sheet)
  symbols <- as.vector(end_common_up$Gene_Name)
  res <- do_kegg_for_sheet(symbols, sheet_name = sheet)
  if(!is.null(res)) results_list[[sheet]] <- res
}
write.xlsx(results_list, file = "GSEA_unici.xlsx")
```
